'''César Mancillas Amador''' (born 21 May 1958) is a [[Mexican people|Mexican]] politician from the [[National Action Party (Mexico)|National Action Party]]. From 2009 to 2012 he served as Deputy of the [[LXI Legislature of the Mexican Congress]] representing [[Baja California]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Perfil del legislador|url=http://sil.gobernacion.gob.mx/Librerias/pp_PerfilLegislador.php?SID=&Referencia=6910988|publisher=Legislative Information System|accessdate=8 December 2014}}</ref>
